title: Longest Substring Without Repeats
statement:
Find the length of the longest stretch of a string in which no character repeats.

The input is one line of letters, digits, and symbols with no spaces, and it can be empty. A substring is a run of characters that sit next to each other in the string, so `ace` is not a substring of `abcde`. Print the length of the longest substring in which every character is different. An empty line prints `0`. Aim to go through the string once instead of trying every start and end.

Input:

```text
abcabcbb
```

Expected output:

```text
3
```
hints: Keep a window, from a start index to the current index, that holds no repeated character. Grow it on the right one character at a time.

When the new character is already inside the window, move the start just past its earlier copy. A map from each character to the last index where you saw it tells you where that copy is, or a set of the window's characters tells you whether to shrink it.
Only ever move the start forward. A character you last saw before the window's start is not a repeat.
